selector.why: The evidence of a pedunculated ureteral tumor with a vulnerable surface and the specific findings from intravenous urography and retrograde ureteropyelography decided it.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a pedunculated ureteral tumor with a vulnerable surface and the specific findings from intravenous urography and retrograde ureteropyelography decided it.

support_spans: a pedunculated ureteral tumor with a vulnerable surface
Intravenous urography demonstrated a tubular filling defect with partial obstruction of the right mid ureter
Retrograde ureteropyelography confirmed a 5 cm long tubular mass in the mid ureter proximal to the iliac vessels
contradict_spans: Urine cytology and endoscopic biopsy of the lesion and renal pelvis were negative for malignancy
